articles.title: Altcoins lead crypto declines as Asian stocks drop; bitcoin little changed since midnight
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell to just above $80,000 as South Korea’s Kospi plunged 8%, while the CoinDesk 80 fell 2.2% and all but six CoinDesk 100 members declined.

articles.title: AI agents make 138 million crypto payments as U.S. dominates spending on AI models
articles.snippet: U.S.-linked wallets account for just over 88% of tracked AI model payments, dwarfing China’s 0.1% share, according to new Chainalysis research.

articles.title: ‘Bunker mode’ won’t protect your crypto, critics say
articles.snippet: Even if Justin Drake’s prediction that AI could break cryptography proves correct, critics say “bunker mode” is an impractical suggestion that’s unlikely to protect your crypto.

articles.title: Developer Who Cloned Photoshop With AI Just Did the Same to Microsoft Office
articles.snippet: Developer Brandon Thomas used Anthropic's Claude to build free, open-source replicas of Word, Excel and PowerPoint. They're rough, but they show how cheap cloning software has become.

articles.title: Bitcoin Whale That Sat Through Every Crash Since 2020 Just Moved $377M
articles.snippet: A wallet that received 4,581 BTC in March 2020, worth about $40 million then, moved its stash today when it was worth about $377 million.
